format: single FIVE GUYS fast casual restaurant in leased strip-center or urban space (approx. 2,000 to 3,000 sq ft), under a mandatory Development Agreement

invest.quote: The total investment necessary to establish one FIVE GUYS® restaurant under the Development Agreement ranges from $927,850 to $1,375,750. This (i) includes $25,350 that must be paid to the franchisor or its affiliates under the Franchise Agreement and (ii) excludes $50,000 per restaurant

fee.quote: You must pay us an initial franchise fee of $25,000 for the right to establish a single Restaurant under a Franchise Agreement ("Franchise Fee").
fee.note: A Development Agreement is required even for one Restaurant, with a non-refundable Development Fee of $50,000 per Restaurant ($125,000 in Alaska, Hawaii or Puerto Rico) that is not applied to the Franchise Fee. Veterans Program: Franchise Fee reduced by $10,000 to $15,000 for the first Restaurant. 75% of the Franchise Fee may be refunded if no approved location is obtained within 6 months.

royalty.quote: Royalty Fee 6% of Gross Sales. If the Restaurant is located in Alaska, Hawaii or Puerto Rico, the Royalty Fee is 8% of Gross Sales. Weekly on Wednesdays

adFund.quote: Creative Fund Up to 4% of Gross Sales (Currently 2%) ... Local Advertising Not less than 2% of Gross Sales
adFund.note: Creative Fund currently 2%, up to 4%; local advertising up to 2% of Gross Sales; cooperative up to 1.5% credited toward local advertising. Total of Creative Fund, Cooperative and Local Advertising will not exceed 4% of Gross Sales.

otherRecurring.name: Bread Products (Five Guys Bakery)
otherRecurring.amount: Varies, depending on your bread product needs, weekly on Mondays

transferFee.amount: $5,000 to reimburse us for our reasonable costs and expenses in reviewing the transfer application (a similar amount is charged under both the Franchise Agreement and the Development Agreement)

item19.note: We do not make any representations about a franchisee's future financial performance or the past financial performance of company-owned or franchised outlets.

special: Mandatory Development Agreement: $50,000 non-creditable Development Fee per Restaurant on top of the $25,000 Franchise Fee, so $75,350 is actually paid to the franchisor and affiliates per Restaurant (cover excludes the $50,000 from the investment range). Proprietary buns must be bought weekly from affiliate Five Guys Bakery. Alaska, Hawaii and Puerto Rico: $125,000 Development Fee and 8% royalty.
issues: No Item 19 financial performance representation. The cover investment range excludes the $50,000 Development Fee and $2,100 transportation expenses that are payable under the Development Agreement.
